name: Red Table
about: A hand-made tutorial kit: a red paper table where cut-out stickers drop, press and settle and get labelled in boiling marker; hand-drawn marker words that scribble in and out on twos; design-tool type cards with a dashed selection box whose handles drag the word to size; one tall condensed italic serif word filling the frame with an eye as the dot of its i; flipbook numbers that count like pages; an iPad on the table with app screens and a pencil; a black brush card; a cream skeuomorphic plugin panel (knob, faders, pads, presets, LED keys, ANIMATE key) with two letter tiles; condensed italic serif captions. Learned from reference r4, built with ishaan-motion.

display.use: the tall word (scale 0.78 x 2.02) and captions (0.74 x 1.12); load it under the family name InstrumentSerif, never 'Serif'

hand.use: small hand labels on the table

card.use: type cards in a selection box

sound: kits/motion/sfx.js: the engine sfx map by event (key-word, pop, hard-hit, stat, word), added only where the reference has no hit
taste: Keep scribbled words inside a measured max width (1380 design px at sx 0.72); captions never sit on a card, move them under it.
